proposition: GET /v1/banking/search/bankSearch: contract says an authorized bank search returns a 200 BankSearchResult response; implementation does return 404 with no result object when the matching banks collection is empty
GET /basins/{basin-id}: contract says the application/json response is a single basin object; implementation does serialize the selected basin through a singleton list

POST /api/swatch-contracts/internal/subscriptions: contract says the default JSON error response is an Errors envelope with a required errors array; implementation does serialize a single Error object with code, status, title and optional detail directly from exception mappers

GET /oauth2/auth/requests/consent: contract says an already handled request returns one 410 JSON requestWasHandledResponse object; implementation does write that 410 object and then continue to serialize the ordinary request into the same response

GET /self-service/login/flows: contract says input autocomplete is restricted to email, tel, url, current-password, new-password and one-time-code; implementation does include username webauthn in identifier-first login input nodes when that strategy is enabled
PUT /shells/{aasIdentifier}/asset-information: contract says a successful Asset Information update returns 204; implementation does return 200 after setting the Asset Information

GET /locations/with-kind: contract says the successful JSON response contains an array of Location objects; implementation does serialize an array of CwmsIdLocationKind objects with location identifiers and kind identifiers
GET /consumers/{groupid}/instances/{name}/records: contract says ConsumerRecord.value has a non-null string schema; implementation does emit an explicit null value for a record with null Kafka value
DELETE /warden/groups/{id}/members: contract says the required OAuth scope is hydra.groups; implementation does require hydra.warden.groups through the token scope guard
GET /loans/{loanId}: contract says annualInterestRate is an integer; implementation does represent annualInterestRate with a BigDecimal in the serialized loan data
GET /businessdate/{type}: contract says BusinessDateResponse.date has string type; implementation does serialize the LocalDate date as an array containing year, month and day

GET /oauth2/auth/requests/logout: contract says an already handled request returns one 410 JSON requestWasHandledResponse object; implementation does write that 410 object and then continue to serialize the ordinary request into the same response

GET /api/v1/products: contract says min_price and max_price independently filter the lower and upper product price limits; implementation does disable the price predicate whenever either bound is absent

POST /groups/{groupId}/artifacts/{artifactId}/versions: contract says rule-processing failures list 409 and no 422 response; implementation does map an unprocessable Avro schema during compatibility checking to 422

POST /projects: contract says metadata.public accepts only the strings true and false; implementation does copy any nonempty metadata.public string into project storage without checking that allowed set

GET /self-service/login/browser: contract says input autocomplete is restricted to email, tel, url, current-password, new-password and one-time-code; implementation does include username webauthn in identifier-first login input nodes when that strategy is enabled
GET /api/keycloak/config: contract says public-client has string type; implementation does serialize public-client as the boolean true
PUT /submodels/{submodelIdentifier}/submodel-elements/{idShortPath}/attachment: contract says a successful file upload returns 204; implementation does return 200 after storing the file

GET /api/v1/products/{productId}/review: contract says a user without a review receives 200 with all review fields null; implementation does throw a NotFoundException mapped to 404 when the user has no review
POST /projects: contract says the project request names its project name property name; implementation does decode and validate the project name only through the project_name property

POST /consumers/{groupid}/instances/{name}/subscription: contract says a subscription request conflicting with an existing partition assignment returns 409 because subscription modes are mutually exclusive; implementation does check only simultaneous topics and topic_pattern in the request body and proceed without checking the existing partition assignment
